name: Osteochondral Lesion of the Knee - Traumatic
tags: osteochondral lesion of the knee - traumatic
definition: Traumatic injury involving articular cartilage and underlying subchondral bone of the knee, sometimes producing loose bodies or mechanical symptoms.

investigations.principle: MRI defines osteochondral injury; radiographs may show larger fragments.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Large unstable fragments may require fixation or cartilage-restoration procedures.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu Asthi-Sandhi injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic injury involving articular cartilage and underlying subchondral bone of the knee, sometimes producing loose bodies or mechanical symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
